NREL (2025). 2025 Annual Technology Baseline: Electricity (ATBe 2025 data file). Golden, CO: National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly National Renewable Energy Laboratory). https://atb.nrel.gov/electricity/2025/

Source: ATBe 2025.csv (long format, 320 MB, atb_year 2025). Filtered with python/pandas to heat-relevant technologies: NaturalGas_FE (F/H-frame CC 1-on-1 and 2-on-1 with and without 95/97% CCS, F-frame CT, fuel cell with and without 98% CCS), NaturalGas_Retrofits (CC capture retrofits 90/95%), Coal_FE (new, IGCC, with CCS), Biopower (dedicated), CSP (classes 2, 3, 8), Geothermal (hydrothermal, near-field EGS, deep EGS; binary and flash), Nuclear (large, small, microreactor). Skipped: wind, PV, hydro, pumped storage, batteries (electric storage only, no heat output), coal retrofits, biopower-CCS (one parameter row only). Filter: scenario Moderate, financial case 'R&D' (the file offers R&D and Exp; no tax-credit cases), crpyears duplicates collapsed (values identical across 20/30/45... year CRPs). Each technology is split into separate processes for ATB years 2023 (base), 2030 and 2050; nuclear starts 2030 and fuel cells 2035 in the file so their first year replaces 2023 (and fuel cell has no 2030). Loaded: OCC as capex (overnight, excl. financing and grid connection), Additional OCC for retrofits (incremental), fixed and variable O&M, heat rate converted to electric efficiency (3.412142/HR; HHV assumed), capacity factor (fraction*100), share-to-capture from the CCS percentage in the technology name. In other-values: ATB CAPEX (incl. financing and GCC), GCC, fuel cost, retrofit heat-rate and net-output penalties, CRP years. Lifetime is NOT in the file (crpyears is a financial recovery period, not life), so no lifetime rows. Locator: ATBe 2025.csv core_metric_key plus year. Auditable copy of all rows used: nrel_2025_annual-technology-baseline-electricity_subset.csv. Traps: (1) all numbers are per kW or MWh of ELECTRIC output - no heat output; ATB has no CHP; heat-supply relevance is via cycle costs only. (2) Price year is not in the file (ATB 2025 uses 2023 USD per its documentation) - rows flagged PRICE YEAR NOT STATED with 2025 per spec; coordinator may correct to 2023. (3) CCS plant rows INCLUDE CAPTURE (whole-plant costs, not split). (4) Moderate scenario value for 2030/2050 of mature technologies is often identical to base year. (5) ATB renamed NREL to National Laboratory of the Rockies in 2025 (references in file). (6) Financial case: the file's cases are R&D and Exp (plus tax-credit variants); the heat-relevant technologies exist only in the R&D case (Exp covers wind/PV/storage etc.), so R&D is the only choice. Values for these technologies are identical with and without tax credits.
